trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libass_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"data/size","code":"ASS_Track *track = ass_read_memory(ass_library, (char *)data, size, nullptr);","note":"The fuzz input is parsed as an ASS subtitle document."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1342,"var":"newbuf","code":"memcpy(newbuf, buf, bufsize); newbuf[bufsize] = '\\0';","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass.c","function":"ass_read_memory","line":1346,"var":"track","code":"track = parse_memory(library, buf);","note":"The subtitle parser produces track and event structures from the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_parse.c","function":"parse_tags","line":527,"var":"render_priv->state.family.len","code":"render_priv->state.family.len = args->end - start;","note":"The \fn() override stores an empty font family string view with zero length."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libass/ass_render.c","function":"update_font","line":1002,"var":"render_priv->state.family.len","code":"desc.family = render_priv->state.family; if (!desc.family.str) return;","note":"The empty font family view is transferred into the font descriptor while remaining non-NULL."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_cache_template.h","function":"<global>","line":41,"var":"p->member.str / p->member.len","code":"hval = fnv_32a_buf(p->member.str, p->member.len, hval);","note":"The font cache hashes the family string using the string-view length."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/libass/libass/ass_utils.h","function":"<global>","line":186,"var":"len == 0","code":"static inline uint32_t fnv_32a_buf(const void *buf, size_t len, uint32_t hval)","note":"The helper does not special-case empty input, so the loop dereferences buf even for an empty string and crashes."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(dumps(trace))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
print(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read())
PY
